data.short_meaning: Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness
data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿāfiya (عافية) 'health, well-being, soundness', from the root ʿ-f-w. Aafiyah therefore means “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness”. Arabic noun ʿāfiya 'health, well-being'; spelling variant of Aafia.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aafiyah expresses “Healthy, Sound”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿāfiya (عافية) 'health, well-being, soundness', from the root ʿ-f-w.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafiyah total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

faq.q: Is Aafiyah the same name as Aafia?
faq.a: Yes - Aafiyah, Aafiya and Aafia are English spellings of the same Arabic name عافية, meaning 'health, well-being'.

faq.q: What does the name Aafiyah mean?
faq.a: Aafiyah means “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aafiyah come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aafiyah?
faq.a: The root of Aafiyah is ع-ف-و (ʿ-f-w).

faq.q: How is Aafiyah written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aafiyah is written عافية in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aafiyah a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafiyah is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aafiyah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aafiyah is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aafiyah verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness” is established by Arabic noun ʿāfiya 'health, well-being'; spelling variant of Aafia..
